item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 10 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Rainfall Advisory No. 10 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 11:00 AM, 01 September 2026(Tuesday)

Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains are expected over Bulacan, Cavite(Ternate, Naic, Maragondon, Magallanes, General Emilio Aguinaldo, Alfonso, Indang, Mendez, Amadeo), Rizal(Rodriguez, San Mateo), Batangas(Nasugbu) and Metro Manila(Valenzuela, Quezon City, Caloocan).

Light to moderate rains affecting Bataan(Dinalupihan, Hermosa), Pampanga(Lubao, Floridablanca, Guagua, Santa Rita, Bacolor, San Fernando, Porac, Arayat, Santa Ana, Santo Tomas, Angeles, Mabalacat, Magalang, Mexico), Tarlac(San Jose, Mayantoc, Bamban, Capas), Zambales(Palauig, Iba, Botolan, Cabangan, San Marcelino) and Nueva Ecija(Cabiao, Aliaga, Cabanatuan, Talavera, Santo Domingo) and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 2:00 PM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to www.pagasa.dost.gov.ph.

item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 32 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 32 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 2:00 PM, 31 August 2026(Monday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Zambales(Botolan, Cabangan, Candelaria, Iba, Masinloc, Palauig, Santa Cruz, San Felipe, San Narciso) and Tarlac(Camiling, Mayantoc, San Clemente, San Jose, Santa Ignacia, Capas).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.


Meanwhile, expect light to moderate with occasional heavy rains over Bataan and Bulacan(Angat, Balagtas, Bocaue, Bustos, Malolos, Guiguinto, Norzagaray, Pandi, Paombong, Plaridel, Santa Maria, Calumpit, Hagonoy, Bulakan, Baliuag, Dona Remedios Trinidad, Pulilan, San Ildefonso, San Rafael, San Miguel) within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Nueva Ecija, Tarlac(Concepcion, Tarlac City, Gerona, La Paz, Paniqui, Pura, Ramos, Victoria, Bamban, Anao, San Manuel, Moncada), Pampanga(Arayat, Bacolor, Candaba, San Fernando, Magalang, Mexico, San Luis, San Simon, Santa Ana, Santo Tomas, Angeles, Mabalacat, Guagua, Porac, Santa Rita) and Zambales(Castillejos, San Antonio, San Marcelino) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 5:00 PM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to www.pagasa.dost.gov.ph.
